principles: Hard failure is reserved for truth provenance numeric identity permission security and canonical lineage violations, or for transport storage and safety capacity exhaustion.
Schema and protocol deviations that can be retained and repaired without changing research facts are recoverable findings, not reasons to erase valid upstream work.
Analytical quality and user-fit are scored and reviewed separately from hard integrity.
Model outputs should contain bounded judgment atoms references and enums; canonical IDs structure lineage and deterministic expansion remain locally owned.
Prompt schema validator and fake Provider must derive from one versioned contract source.
Historical evidence may prove a capability cumulatively, but may not be composed into a terminal product that no single coherent Run actually produced.

acceptance_layers.purpose: Protect research truth, authority, security and reconstructability.
gates: no fabricated or unsupported material claim
exact Evidence Fact Claim Numeric and Artifact provenance
entity business scope period currency unit scale formula and attribution integrity
canonical identity lineage and same-scope reference validity
permission secret network tool source and writer-authority boundaries
no silent fallback substitution promotion normalization or immutable-output rewrite
terminal state idempotency capture and process identity consistency
transport storage or safety capacity is not exhausted

acceptance_layers.purpose: Keep structurally usable work while routing deterministic repair.
gates: request validator and fake Provider contract alignment
hard_failure_escalation: the deviation makes the output ambiguous or unsafe to parse
repair would require guessing identity fact numeric or authority
transport storage or security envelope is exceeded

acceptance_layers.purpose: Measure usefulness without confusing style with truth.
Adapt the product to user expertise and delivery context.

hard_capacity_examples: provider request or response byte envelope
context or token budget whose exhaustion prevents safe completion
forbidden_repairs: captured-output rewrite presented as original model output

runtime_state_model.terminal_success: all required nodes and canonical artifacts complete with L1 pass
runtime_state_model.succeeded_with_quality_findings: all required nodes and canonical artifacts complete with L1 pass and one or more L3 or L4 findings
runtime_state_model.recoverable_partial: valid outputs are retained but required downstream nodes or artifacts are incomplete
runtime_state_model.terminal_hard_failure: an L1 violation or unrecoverable L2 violation occurred

stage_acceptance.engineering_integrity: runtime identity lineage boundaries and deterministic contracts pass
stage_acceptance.product_completeness: one coherent exact Run contains every required current-version Artifact
stage_acceptance.research_quality: four-layer review and paired comparison are completed with findings explicitly dispositioned
stage_acceptance.owner_acceptance: an authorized owner binds acceptance to exact artifact versions and digests
stage_acceptance.progression_rule: A slice may advance only when the acceptance declared by that slice is evidenced; quality debt may carry forward, but missing product artifacts or L1 defects may not.

implementation_guidance.provider_output: small judgment atoms scoped aliases references enums and concise rationales
implementation_guidance.local_deterministic_ownership: canonical IDs structure lineage dependency conflict gap assembly and exact validation
implementation_guidance.contract_generation: one source generates Provider schema local validator fake Provider fixtures and telemetry subtype vocabulary
